#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    std::stack<int> digits;
    int cntr = 0;
    while (m > 0) {
        if (cntr == 40) {
            throw std::out_of_range("cntr");
        }
        digits.push(m % w);
        m /= w;
        cntr++;
    }

    std::stack<int> process;
    process.push(0);
    while (!digits.empty()) {
        process.push(digits.top());
        digits.pop();
    }

    bool flag = true;
    while (!process.empty()) {
        int d = process.top();
        process.pop();
        if (d != 0 && d != 1 && d != w && d != w - 1) {
            flag = false;
            break;
        }
        if (d == w || d == w - 1) {
            if (!process.empty()) {
                int next = process.top();
                process.pop();
                process.push(next + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << (flag ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
